captions.ru: Ancient Greek philosophers ne ek cheez kahi thi: The Ship of Theseus
captions.en: Ancient Greek philosophers posed a puzzle: the Ship of Theseus

captions.ru: Agar ek ship hai…
captions.en: Imagine there's a ship…

captions.ru: aur hum uski har ek lakdi ka hissa
captions.en: and we take each of its wooden planks

captions.ru: baar baar badalte jaayein, badalte jaayein
captions.en: and keep replacing them, again and again

captions.ru: Pehle din ek lakdi ka hissa badla
captions.en: Day one, we swap out a single plank

captions.ru: To kya yeh abhi bhi Ship of Theseus hai? Kya yeh wahi ship hai?
captions.en: Is it still the Ship of Theseus? The same ship?

captions.ru: To kya woh same ship hai ya alag ship?
captions.en: So is it the same ship, or a different one?

captions.ru: Agar alag hai, to kab hui alag?
captions.en: If it's different, when did it become different?

captions.ru: Aur yehi masla insaanon ke saath bhi aata hai
captions.en: And the same problem comes up with humans

captions.ru: Insaan ki jo physical body hai…
captions.en: The human physical body…

captions.ru: 10 se 15 saal mein saare physical cells
captions.en: within 10 to 15 years, all its cells

captions.ru: change ho jaate hain. Naye cells aate hain, purane mar jaate hain
captions.en: get replaced. New cells come, old ones die

captions.ru: Bachcha paida hota hai, 10 saal ka hota hai, physically sab badal chuka
captions.en: A child is born; by ten, physically everything has changed

captions.ru: Hum obviously kahenge: haan, yeh wahi bachcha hai jo paida hua tha
captions.en: Obviously we'd say: yes, it's the same child who was born

captions.ru: Yahan materialistic philosophy collapse kar jaati hai
captions.en: This is where materialist philosophy collapses

captions.ru: Insaan bunyadi taur par do cheezon ka murakkab hai
captions.en: A human is fundamentally made of two things

captions.ru: Ek body, jo matter hai, physical hai
captions.en: A body, which is matter, physical

captions.ru: Aur doosri cheez roohani hai, spiritual
captions.en: And the other is spiritual

captions.ru: Ek alag substance, jisko hum soul kehte hain
captions.en: A separate substance we call the soul

captions.ru: Physical body complete replace ho rahi hai
captions.en: The physical body gets completely replaced

captions.ru: lekin soul apne substance mein nahi badalti, develop hoti hai
captions.en: but the soul doesn't change in substance; it develops

captions.ru: Aur is se saare issues khatam ho jaate hain
captions.en: And that resolves the whole puzzle

captions.ru: Insaan ki agar poori physicality khatam kar di jaaye
captions.en: Even if a person's entire physical self is gone

captions.ru: jo maut mein hoga, aur wapas laa di jaaye
captions.en: as in death, and is brought back

captions.ru: phir bhi woh wahi insaan hoga
captions.en: he will still be the same person

captions.ru: kyunke jo substance usko insaan banata hai, woh wahi hai
captions.en: because the substance that makes him human is the same

verses.ar: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنشَأَهَا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Say, He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing.
